item.title: North Webster Community Center hosts 'Casino Night' fundraiser
item.description: NORTH WEBSTER, Ind. -- The North Webster Community Center is inviting community members 18 and older to its "Casino Night" fundraiser on Saturday at 5:30 p.m.

item.title: Gas prices increase after strike on Iran
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- Drivers are currently paying more than three dollars for a gallon of gas in Michiana due to the impacts from the US and Israeli strikes oversees.

item.title: How Oaklawn's 'Open-Access' model is saving lives
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. — Oaklawn's transition into a "Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic" (CCBHC) has allowed clinicians to completely transform the way they care for patients.

item.title: Monday morning Elkhart shooting
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. — 19-year-old male is dead after a shooting early Monday morning.

item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- On Monday local organizations packed meals for a school backpack program to begin March Meal Madness.

item.title: Protesters rally in Niles to voice frustration with State of Union
item.description: NILES, Mich. -- On Monday at the corner of main and Second Street, the Coalition for Democracy Southwest Michigan protested the State of the Union address that took place Feb. 24.

item.title: Downtown Goshen hosts Goshen Gives Back night
item.description: GOSHEN, Ind. -- Downtown Goshen is set to host Goshen Gives Back on Mar. 6 from 5 p.m. to 9 p.m. for First Friday fun while also raising crucial funds for nonprofit organizations that do important work throughout the Elkhart County community.

item.title: Town of Akron awarded $750,000 grant for wastewater project
item.description: AKRON, Ind. -- The Town of Akron announced they have been awarded a $750,000 grant from the Indiana Office of Community and Rural Affairs (OCRA) to support an upcoming wastewater infrastructure project.

item.title: Family of Michigan City Double Homicide victim demand justice
item.description: MICHIGAN CITY, Ind. -- The family of Eddie Nixon is demanding justice, following frustrating delays from court.

item.title: US Congressman Rudy Yakym shows support for St. Joseph County Sheriff candidate Rod Laureys
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. — U.S. Congressman Rudy Yakym made a stop home Monday evening to show support towards a candidate running for Saint Joseph County Sheriff.
